summary: Reproduced the zero-token failure through the real SGLang MoeRunner flashinfer_mxfp4 wrapper with an instrumented external CUTLASS boundary. Added shape validation and a valid-empty return after routing materialization and symmetric output allocation, preserving output shape, BF16 dtype, device, and pre-kernel collective obligations. The nonempty control still invokes the external boundary; malformed empty routing is rejected.

remaining_limitations: The assigned GPU is AMD Instinct MI350X; the NVIDIA H20/SM90 FlashInfer CUTLASS kernel could not be executed.

The reported four-rank DP-attention plus two-batch-overlap end-to-end server scenario and its collectives remain unverified because four H20 GPUs and the DeepSeek-V4-Flash checkpoint were not available.
The regression instruments only the external FlashInfer kernel boundary; it verifies SGLang wrapper behavior and GPU tensor contracts, not FlashInfer kernel execution on NVIDIA hardware.
No native code changed, so no native library rebuild was applicable.
